name: 鳗尾兽
evolution: 花怨鳗 → 鳗尾兽 Lv.26
description: 它们的头部几乎没有视力，主要靠嘴感受气流来调整方向，偶尔会在地表横冲直撞。吼叫时会带动口中的吊钟形花朵震动，发出阵阵钟声。它们和同伴间通过这些声响，彼此交流。
descriptionEn: Their heads have almost no vision, and they mainly sense airflow with their mouths to adjust direction, occasionally charging recklessly across the surface. When they roar, the bell-shaped flower in their mouth vibrates, emitting waves of bell sounds. They communicate with companions through these sounds.
